hook_text: Three heads in a row. Is tails due next? The coin does not remember.
clip_script: A maths games afternoon in Bethlehem. Toss a coin: 2 outcomes, heads or tails. Roll a die: 6 outcomes, 1 to 6. Spin a 4-colour spinner: 4 outcomes. Lindiwe tosses 20 times: heads 11, tails 9. Not 10 and 10, and that is normal. Pieter rolls 20 times: 4 comes up most. Lucky number? No. Next time it could be different. A spinner that is half red: red comes up 11 times out of 20. A bigger part, a bigger chance. List what could happen, then count what did happen.
visual_style: A coin flipping in slow motion, tally marks appearing, then a half-red spinner whirring to a stop.
mood: Playful and curious, like a games day with friends.
pacing: Quick flips and rolls, a pause on the 11 and 9, then the spinner reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and toss a coin 20 times to see your own results.
